{{Top}}
'''Supreme Admiral''' was a rank assigned to the commander of the [[Exocron Airfleet]], and its successor, the [[Exocron Combined Air-Space Fleet]]. In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], [[Horzao Darr]] was known to hold this rank.
